learning_outcomes.text: Develop skills for designing, elaborating execution and technological documentation, evaluating and rehabilitating the technical state and components of technical systems. Orient towards technically and economically optimized actions, using current and open-ended concepts and solutions.
Elaborate manufacturing technology for specific mechanical components.
Perform maintenance activities for technical systems.
Know the technology for reconditioning degraded components.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of manufacturing technology elaboration: Structure of manufacturing systems. Principles and concepts in the design and manufacturing of technical systems. Standardization in the construction of technological equipment. Quality engineering and management.

Specific manufacturing technologies: Machining technologies: external, internal, flat, profiled, complex surfaces of revolution, non-abrasive machining technologies with superhard tools. Plastic deformation and separation technologies with associated cutting edges applied to flat semi-finished products. Technology of plastic components. Assembly and mounting technology. Non-dismountable joining technologies.
Maintenance and rehabilitation of technical systems: Degradation, risk, and safety in the operation of technical systems. Maintenance strategies. Rehabilitation/recovery of mechanical components.
Analysis of the manufacturability of component constructive shapes
Influence of the technological itinerary on the precision of the machined part
Influence of clamping forces of the workpiece on the precision of mechanical processing
Influence of thermal deformations of the technological system on the quality of manufactured parts
Study of the construction and operation of cold pressing tools
Unconventional material joining processes
Repair and reconditioning of metal parts by weld overlay.
Elaboration of manufacturing technology for mechanical components (part ..., drawing ..., part of equipment ... for ... pieces)
Definition of the functional role of the component
Description and calculation of stresses the component is subjected to in operation
Constructive-technological analysis of the execution drawing
Selection and characterization of the base material
Determination of production type
Selection of the semi-finished product and calculation of the utilization rate of the base material
Elaboration of the technological itinerary
Specification of technological equipment
Calculation of processing parameters for technological operations
Calculation of the technical time standard for technological operations
Establishment of occupational safety and fire prevention measures during component processing
Elaboration of the component's execution drawing
Preparation of the technological sheet
Elaboration of the operations plan.
teaching_methods: Group project work (two students per group)

assessment_methods.method: Theoretical knowledge evaluation (average of 3 written tests)

assessment_rules: The grade for theoretical knowledge is the arithmetic mean of three written tests, provided each test score is 5 or higher. The final grade is calculated as 60% from theoretical knowledge evaluation, 15% from laboratory activities, and 25% from the project. To pass the course, students must achieve a minimum grade of 5 for 50% knowledge of each subject and successfully complete both laboratory and project activities.
